summary.text: A car pulls forward out of the dark into faint light.

description.text: A continuous scene opens in near-total darkness. The

begins as a dense, barely legible silhouette at the far edge of the view, its body held in deep shadow and its form defined only by the faintest separation from the black around it. The floor beneath it is uneven concrete with a wet sheen, catching a few weak reflections that hint at the space without fully revealing it. The car eases forward, slow and deliberate, its shape growing more present as it advances toward the viewer. At first only the leading edge and the low sweep of the hood can be made out; then a shallow pool of pale light reaches across the ground ahead, and the car's front enters it. The light is faint and narrowly contained, falling from an unseen overhead source, and it does not brighten the whole scene. Instead it picks out a smooth hood, narrow headlight shapes, and a thin line of chrome trim, each surface appearing briefly before the surrounding blackness swallows the rest. The car continues to roll forward at a measured pace, its motion steady rather than fast, while the contrast between the lit nose and the dark rear stretches the silhouette. Small reflections slide along the wet concrete and break apart under the tires. The car's advance is the only clear change: it starts as an obscure mass in the dark and becomes a readable vehicle as it crosses into the light, though the space beyond remains featureless and unlit. No other objects enter the view, and the atmosphere stays quiet and enclosed around the advancing form. The scene holds on this unfolding reveal, keeping the car within the narrow band of illumination as the darkness presses in around it.
